acme-agent   native  -  acme --acp --mode=stdio
    A probe by name runs: acme version --short, then acme --acp --mode=stdio
    A plugin chose the command or its arguments, so agentflow never probes it automatically, for an agent or in a probe of every harness. Probe it by name if you trust it.
      agentflow ai harnesses --probe --id acme-agent
quiet-agent  native  -  quiet acp
    A probe by name runs: quiet acp, with no version command
    A plugin chose the command or its arguments, so agentflow never probes it automatically, for an agent or in a probe of every harness. Probe it by name if you trust it.
      agentflow ai harnesses --probe --id quiet-agent
